name: Have I Been Pwned Breach Monitor with Risk Scoring, Email and Slack Alerts

parameters.content:
## 🔐 Have I Been Pwned breach monitor with risk scoring

Checks Have I Been Pwned once a day, scores the newest breach against your own risk criteria, logs every result to Google Sheets, and alerts you only when the score clears your threshold.

### How it works
1. Runs daily at 08:00, or on demand with the manual trigger.
2. Creates the 16 column header row the first time it runs.
3. Pulls the latest breach from the public HIBP API. No API key needed.
4. Skips breaches already in your sheet unless HIBP has updated them.
5. Scores blast radius, data sensitivity, HIBP flags and your watchlist into LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL.
6. Appends the scored breach to Google Sheets, whether or not it alerts.
7. Sends an HTML email and a Slack card when the score clears your threshold.

### Setup
- [ ] Create an empty Google Sheet and copy its ID from the URL
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and Slack credentials (Slack needs `chat:write`)
- [ ] In **Set Workflow Variables**, fill in `sheetId`, `sheetTabName`, `alertRecipient` and `slackChannel`
- [ ] Add your own domains and keywords to the two watchlist fields
- [ ] Run **Run Now (Manual Test)** once, then activate the workflow

### Customization
- `minimumSeverity` sets the alert floor: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL
- Edit the weights in **Score Breach Severity** to match your risk appetite
- Enable the optional SMTP or webhook nodes to send alerts somewhere else

## 1. Trigger and settings
Runs daily at 08:00 or on demand. **Set Workflow Variables** holds every value you need to edit.

## 2. Prepare the Google Sheet
Reads row 1 and writes the header row automatically on the first run, so you never build the sheet by hand.

## 3. Fetch and deduplicate
Pulls the latest breach from Have I Been Pwned and stops quietly if it is already logged and unchanged.

## 4. Score and log
Rates the breach LOW to CRITICAL, then appends it to your sheet whether or not it triggers an alert.

## 5. Decide whether to alert
Compares the score with your threshold and watchlist. Below threshold, the run ends quietly.

## 6. Send the alert
HTML email through Gmail plus a Slack card. The SMTP and webhook nodes are optional and disabled by default.

## ⚠️ Edit this first
Add your `sheetId`, `sheetTabName` and `alertRecipient` before the first run. Do not rename this node, the Code nodes look it up by name.

nodes.name: Daily Breach Check Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 08:00. Change the hour here, or swap to an interval, to suit your cadence.

nodes.name: Run Now (Manual Test)
nodes.notes: Runs the same flow on demand. Use this for your first run and after any settings change.

nodes.name: Set Workflow Variables
nodes.notes: The only node you need to edit. Paste your Google Sheet ID and tab name here, along with recipient, timezone, alert threshold, watchlist and Slack channel. Do not rename this node, the Code nodes look it up by name.

nodes.name: Check for Header Row
nodes.notes: Reads row 1 of the sheet named in Set Workflow Variables. A brand new tab returns no values, which triggers the next node.

nodes.name: Header Row Missing?
nodes.notes: True when row 1 is empty. True builds the header first, false goes straight to the fetch. Only one path runs.

nodes.name: Create Header Row
nodes.notes: Writes the 16 column names once, so you never have to build the sheet by hand. Edit here if you change the schema.

nodes.name: Fetch Latest Breach from Have I Been Pwned API
nodes.notes: Calls the public latestbreach endpoint. No API key needed, but HIBP requires the user-agent header set below.

nodes.name: Read Breach History from Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the sheet named in Set Workflow Variables. Always Output Data is on so an empty sheet still runs the comparison.

nodes.name: Check if Breach is New or Updated
nodes.notes: Compares name plus Modified/Added date against the history. Returns nothing when already seen, ending the run quietly.

nodes.name: Score Breach Severity
nodes.notes: Scores exposure size, data types, HIBP flags and your watchlist into a number and a LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL band. Weights are at the top.

nodes.name: Save Scored Breach to Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Writes the scored row to the sheet named in Set Workflow Variables. Matches on Name, so a revised breach updates its own row instead of adding a duplicate.

nodes.name: Above Alert Threshold?
nodes.notes: Decides notify or log only. Everything is already saved to the sheet by this point.

nodes.name: Format Breach Alert Email
nodes.notes: Builds the responsive HTML email, including the card that explains why this alert fired.

nodes.name: Send Breach Alert via Gmail
nodes.notes: Sends the alert. Delete this branch and use the SMTP node instead if you do not use Gmail.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Severity }}] {{ $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Title }} | {{ Number($('Score Breach Severity').first().json.PwnCount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') }} accounts exposed

nodes.name: Logged Only, No Alert Sent
nodes.notes: Quiet exit. The breach is in your sheet but sat below your threshold, so nothing was sent. This is not an error.

nodes.name: Format Slack Block Kit Message
nodes.notes: Builds the Slack card: colour bar, score meter, status tags, breakdown and action buttons.

nodes.name: Post Slack Card
nodes.notes: Posts the Slack card. Select your Slack credential (needs chat:write) and confirm slackChannel in Set Workflow Variables before running.

nodes.name: Optional: Send to Teams or Generic Webhook
nodes.notes: Disabled. Wired to the alert branch so its expressions resolve, but it does not run until you enable it. POSTs the scored breach as JSON to Teams, PagerDuty, or a SIEM collector.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Severity, title: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Title, domain: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Domain, pwnCount: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.PwnCount, dataClasses: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.DataClassesText, reasons: $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.ScoreReasons }) }}

nodes.name: Optional: Send via SMTP Instead of Gmail
nodes.notes: Disabled. Wired after Format Breach Alert Email so its expressions resolve, but it does not run until you enable it. Enable this and disable the Gmail node to send the same HTML through your own mail server.

parameters.subject: =[{{ $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Severity }}] New breach: {{ $('Score Breach Severity').first().json.Title }}
